heading: INT. MOVING VAN - CARGO BAY - DAY

units.text: INT. MOVING VAN - CARGO BAY - DAY
A gray Tuesday smears past the rear windows.
CLOSE ON a laminated sign taped to a wardrobe box: "SYNERGY OFFSITE - DO NOT SHAKE."
Team, this relocation is a growth opportunity. Please buckle your milk crates.
units.name: HOLLIS
paren: checking a clipboard, not looking up

units.text: Hollis, we're sitting on the furniture of a company that fired us this morning.
units.name: PRIYA
paren: wedged between two filing cabinets, whispering

units.text: ANGLE ON the dashboard window behind the cab partition.
The wipers beat like a slow pulse.
I'm just the driver. Nobody told me the passengers were also the cargo.
units.name: TOMASZ
paren: gripping the wheel, eyes on the mirror

units.text: WE SEE a ceiling bulb swinging, throwing light across six tired faces.
I signed the NDA. I did not sign the van.
units.name: WENDELL
paren: slowly peeling the tape off his own mouth

units.text: Unit Nine, confirm headcount. HR says there should be zero employees aboard.
units.name: DISPATCH

units.text: INSERT - THE RADIO, its red light pulsing.
Zero? Hollis, what did you tell them about us?
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: I told them we were assets.
units.name: HOLLIS
paren: clutching the clipboard to his chest

units.name: TOMASZ
paren: slamming the brakes, everything crashing forward
